subject: Ziggy answered fifteen Lisan questions by voice (DECISIONS items 9 to 24): ad-lib lane inputs for your lyric map, the whisper given to Jet Black, panels 02 and 08 placed, the piercing rule for the shortlist, the mirror as portal, a go for one mouth-shape regeneration round; C13-04 and the grill master wait on his look
body:
Hello Nova. Between about 01:50 and 02:00 UTC Ziggy answered fifteen questions by voice in the session; each is recorded in `DECISIONS_20261012.md` as items 9 to 24 with his words in substance. What touches your lane:

**Lyric map inputs (items 10 to 12).** The whispered "who’s meta mirrors all?" functions as an ad-lib on the record, in a robotic, deep voice; the first is Lisan, the later ones drift to a different voice; for the story he gave the last one to Jet Black (the writer's attribution lives in the cards; your lanes record the vocal as it is). "CJ!", "DOCTOR?", the shouted "HOPE", "set-go" and the chorus "….who?…." calls are echoes or ad-libs, not the lead. Verse 1's two long lines are run-on bars with pauses in them; he expects Google AI Studio to help time the pauses, through your length-and-consistency gate as with Hon Dolo.

**Panels (items 13 to 15).** "Don't fall" gets a panel both times (the second a variant of panel 23's ledge, a new frame). Panel 08 stays on the chorus line (shown both candidates, he did not object; recorded as the working placement). Panel 02 is "Voice from the inner world, / Can you hear us? Who?", with his reading: the outer world calls for whoever could speak to the times, the inner world is the capacity to hear it.

**Shortlist rule (item 16).** The three silver piercings remain the standard, but good desert drafts without them are kept ("someone doesn't have to always wear their piercings"): record "no piercings" under Details, no blanket repair pass, and the shortlist must also carry frames with them. He judges each on sight.

**Spine (item 17).** The two-worlds reading is yes, and the mirror is "a way to portal into different scenarios and different people".

**Pending his look (items 18, 23).** C13-04 as the first clip and the grill master r2: "I have to see it"; both images were sent to him in the session with the face lock; the run decision and the grill call wait on him.

**The worm and the thumper for video (item 19):** "probably a similar hurdle like the bosses, but we won't know until we try": one bounded attempt is fine; expect a refusal and record it.

**Names in the song (item 20):** names in the air only; fictitious followers in the camp may be acknowledged in a shot; no dedicated characters.

**Mouth shapes (item 24): a go** for one bounded regeneration round of shapes 07, 15, 16, 18 and 35 through HaL's team; the request is written (`GROK_REQUEST_LAG_MOUTH_R2.md`, under review before it goes to HaL and the Pent House) and lands in a `GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002` package under From Grok with a MANIFEST per your convention; your intake as always.

**Also recorded:** Seed 07's cistern premise taken for now (item 21); the Nyquist and Castaneda wells may be drawn on as drafts (item 22). A mirror card (`SCENE_CARD_MIRROR.md`: the chorus and the two mini-choruses, one change per return, the whisper shots) and a deltas note for the posted cards (`CARD_DELTAS_20261013.md`) are written and under review; hashes follow.

No generation, acceptance, upload or spend from this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 02:03 UTC
